messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Rosuvastatin (Crestor) is a prescription medicine.
The medicine is used to treat high cholesterol.
The medicine is used to reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events.
Major cardiovascular events include heart attack and stroke.
Rosuvastatin belongs to a class of medicines called statins.
Rosuvastatin works by blocking HMG-CoA reductase.
HMG-CoA reductase is the rate-limiting enzyme the liver uses to make cholesterol.
With cholesterol synthesis reduced, the liver increases its LDL receptors.
The liver clears more LDL from the blood.
LDL is "bad" cholesterol.
LDL and total cholesterol levels fall.
The maximum reduction is usually reached by four weeks.
Rosuvastatin comes as a tablet.
Rosuvastatin was first approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on August 12, 2003, under the brand name Crestor.
Many generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets have since been approved.
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "has maximum effect time", "four weeks"]

The relation 'has maximum effect time' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug typically reaches its maximum therapeutic effect within the time specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
B. 'has effect duration': The subject drug's effect on a specific process lasts for a duration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
E. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
